sentences.text: JUDGMENT
Learned counsel for the appellant seeks short accommodation for compliance of office objection.
2. On perusal of the records, the appeal was filed on 11.01.2023.

In spite of more than one year,
office objections have not been complied.
Hence, on 25.03.2024, a peremptory order was passed granting one week's time to comply the office objections, failing which, the matter shall be listed for dismissal.
Even after lapse of three months, the counsel for the appellant has not complied the office objections.
Therefore, there is no question of granting any more time for adjournment to comply the office objections.
3. Appeal is dismissed for default.

Sd/-
